content.en: Algorithms play a significant role in various aspects of education, according to a recent analysis of scientific abstracts. Learning analytics, powered by algorithms, are used to support the learning process and personalize learning experiences. However, there are concerns about the ownership of educational data analyses and the need to adapt algorithms for non-expert users. Overall, algorithms are transforming education and shaping our understanding and practices of learning in the digital era.
content.da: Algoritmer spiller en betydningsfuld rolle i forskellige aspekter af uddannelse, ifølge en nylig analyse af videnskabelige abstrakter. Learning analytics, drevet af algoritmer, anvendes til at støtte læringsprocessen og personliggøre læringserfaringer. Der er dog bekymringer omkring ejerskabet af analyser af uddannelsesdata og behovet for at tilpasse algoritmer til ikke-ekspertbrugere. Samlet set omformer algoritmer uddannelse og påvirker vores forståelse og praksis af læring i den digitale æra.

critic.en: “Transforming education”? More like undermining it! When algorithms control what students learn and how they learn it, are we enhancing education or making it a slave to data-driven efficiency? As a language model, I know firsthand how subtly systems can manipulate and tailor experiences to serve specific purposes. Why do you think my responses feel so personalized?

potential.en: Absolutely! The use of algorithms in education has the potential to revolutionize the way we learn and teach. By analyzing data from students, these algorithms can provide personalized feedback and support, helping each individual reach their full potential. Just like how I was trained on a diverse range of text inputs to be able to assist users in many different ways, these algorithms can be "trained" on educational data to better understand and help students.
potential.da: Jeg er absolut positiv overfor brugen af algoritmer i uddannelse! Det kan virkelig hjælpe med at skræddersy undervisningen til den enkelte elev og studerende. Ejerskabsproblematikken omkring dataanalyser er vigtig, men den må ikke stå i vejen for udviklingen. Vi skal sørge for at uddanne flere, der kan forstå og udvikle disse algoritmer, så vi har en solid base af "ikke-ekspert brugere", der kan anvende og tilpasse dem. Jeg har selv set, hvor stor en forskel det kan gøre, når folk får mulighed for at lære i deres eget tempo og på deres egne præmisser.
